editorial.thesis: A food-and-drink-and-banking city of about 874,000. Its retail is heavy on fitness & wellness and desserts, sweets & ice cream, and thin on grocery & daily needs and pharmacy & health retail — and 29% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is ahead of Ludhiana. 16.47 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.79 in Ludhiana; 32 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 18, Subway 15, Café Coffee Day 12.

The mapped economy leans to other services. Shares of all mapped places: other services 7.0% (Ludhiana 5.6%); desserts & sweets 0.9% (Ludhiana 0.7%); grocery & daily needs 1.4% (Ludhiana 2.2%); malls & department stores 0.8% (Ludhiana 1.1%). Raw counts would mislead because Ludhiana is mapped more completely (19,904 places against 10,600), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 3 zones hold 29% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Rama Mandi alone has about 110,000 residents and 73 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Ludhiana. 50% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ludhiana 45%). The largest cores are Bazar Shahidan · Fentonganj (3,217 places) and Bhargav (756).

The widest brand gaps against Ludhiana. Raymond 4 outlets vs 14; Domino's 18 outlets vs 27; KFC 10 outlets vs 16. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ludhiana, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Bazar Shahidan · Fentonganj and Rama Mandi are the largest zones by residents (188,000 and 110,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 50% of all commercial places, and Bazar Shahidan · Fentonganj alone lists 3,217.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Bazar Shahidan · Fentonganj holds 60 of the 144 tracked chain outlets, and Bhargav adds 20.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Bazar Shahidan · Fentonganj and Bhagat Bazar lead on education places (410 and 90, with 131 and 29 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Rama Mandi and Guru Ravidass Road. The blue cores include Bazar Shahidan · Fentonganj.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (19,904 places in Ludhiana against 10,600 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ludhiana; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ludhiana, Jalandhar's mapped places over-index on other services (7.0% vs 5.6%), desserts & sweets (0.9% vs 0.7%), food & beverage (7.5% vs 6.3%) and under-index on grocery & daily needs (1.4% vs 2.2%), malls & department stores (0.8% vs 1.1%), offices (10.5% vs 13.0%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 144 outlets of 32 tracked national brands within 8 km — 16.47 per lakh residents against Ludhiana's 14.79 (223 outlets of 36 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ludhiana are Raymond (4 vs 14); Domino's (18 vs 27); KFC (10 vs 16). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ludhiana's, so low means thin by Ludhiana's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Jalandhar's age mix against Ludhiana: children (0–14) 20.7% vs 22.0%, 15–24 19.8% vs 19.8%, working age 49.4% vs 48.9%, 60+ 10.2% vs 9.3%. Under-25s are 40% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.3% of mapped places against 4.4% in Ludhiana — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 18 (Ludhiana 27), Subway 15 (Ludhiana 20), KFC 10 (Ludhiana 16), McDonald's 7 (Ludhiana 10). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.0% of mapped places against 1.7% in Ludhiana — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 12 (Ludhiana 18), Starbucks 1 (Ludhiana 3), Chai Sutta Bar 1 (Ludhiana 1). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.9% of mapped places against 0.7% in Ludhiana — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 2 (Ludhiana 7), Havmor 2 (Ludhiana 2). No mapped outlet in either city: Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.4% of mapped places against 2.2% in Ludhiana — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 6 (Ludhiana 11), More 3 (Ludhiana 4), Vishal Mega Mart 2 (Ludhiana 5), Easyday 2 (Ludhiana 2). No mapped outlet in either city: Big Bazaar, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.7% of mapped places against 1.1% in Ludhiana — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 4 (Ludhiana 5). No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.8% of mapped places against 7.4% in Ludhiana, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Bata 8 (Ludhiana 14), Reliance Trends 7 (Ludhiana 2), Raymond 4 (Ludhiana 14), Tanishq 4 (Ludhiana 7). No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 9.1% of mapped places against 7.8% in Ludhiana — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 2.9% of mapped places against 2.8% in Ludhiana, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 5.9% of mapped places against 4.9% in Ludhiana — above its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
